title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-wa51: Rust EDHOC transcript_4 uses ciphertext_3 instead of plaintext_3
description: rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:396 transcript_4 function and its call sites (lines 908, 1407) pass CIPHERTEXT_3 where RFC 9528 Section 3.5 specifies PLAINTEXT_3. TH_4 should be H(CBOR(TH_3) || CBOR(PLAINTEXT_3) || CBOR(CRED_I)). The Python edhoc.py was fixed in this commit to use plaintext_3; the Rust implementation has the same bug and was not fixed. This also means the Rust test vectors at line 2113 (th_3) and line 2132 (th_4) in edhoc.rs will need updating after the fix.
